pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Gabbee is a push-to-talk dictation bar for Wayland desktops. Holding its shortcut records the microphone, streams it to a speech provider, and inserts the result into whatever window has keyboard focus through the first delivery route that works: a verified IBus commit, AT-SPI EditableText, a clipboard paste with restoration, or a direct typing tool. A separate shortcut runs saved, schema-validated desktop actions; ordinary dictation can only ever produce text. Transcripts are formatted semantically, so spoken numbers, phone numbers, versions, dates, money and punctuation come out the way they are written.
On the QindaQt desktop Gabbee is also the org.qindaqt.Voice1 provider: it is what the panel's Voice applet, the Settings Voice route and the qindaqt-voice console talk to. That contract is owned by the desktop and implemented here, so either side can be replaced independently.

use.flag: Install the D-Bus activation file for the QindaQt desktop's org.qindaqt.Voice1 voice contract
Install the IBus engine component, the primary text-delivery route
Enable start, stop and error cues through media-libs/libcanberra
Dictate offline: transcribe on this computer with dev-python/faster-whisper and a model from app-accessibility/faster-whisper-models when online recognition fails
